messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image, using the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please select the video produced by the first hair color change, then use it as the starting point for the following edit: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands on a cobblestone street, then turns his head and upper body to the left and right, briefly showing his profile.","camera":"Static medium shot from behind the character at roughly waist-to-head height.","clothing":"White sleeveless tank top with a teal graphic along the hem, teal shorts, and pink sneakers.","hair_color":"Brown.","hairstyle":"Short brown hair with a tall, swept-up quiff at the back of the head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered male character with a muscular build, shown from behind.","scene":"A sunlit urban street with red-brick buildings, shop awnings, a Union Jack flag, and a street sign on the left."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a bright ocean terrace to a cobblestone street with red-brick buildings, awnings, a Union Jack flag, and street lamps matching the reference. The character remains in a white tank top with teal hem graphic, teal shorts, and pink sneakers, and performs a similar turning motion from behind.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the seaside scene with the reference cobblestone British street environment while preserving the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, action, camera framing, and natural lighting.
uncertain: Whether the character's facial expression was fully preserved, since the face is mostly not visible from the rear camera angle
unexpected_changes: The character's skin tone appears lighter and more rendered in the output than in the source
The character's shadow is much darker and more sharply defined in the new street scene
